Then come the census keyed `operator` and the leg-less after-reads of `XS-2`'s own products, all after the span; then after the landing (`diff -r`, the three layers); then the operator pass. **Revision 1:** entries 1–8 (phase A) are not re-fired; implement starts at entry 9 (step 18). What is not run, and why: no mutation run (`inputs#I1` item 10); no release-check entry (CI's `release` job runs it); between phase B and the landing no stamped-home suite runs (§Steps intro). Every test start runs under a test-owned home and user home; every waiting test takes a bound under the 20 s lint. The live start runs under the rig's private scratch; the rig's `--deadline` bounds it under the entry's `timeout`. The live leg's non-priming probes are the round entries ahead of it. `XS` and `XS-2` are ledgered in `.andromeda/cache/chunks/2026-11-21-cross-session-prefix-ledger-row/evidence/cross-starts.ndjson`; `--cap` is the running total of base lines in that one file (`XS` stands as line 1, so `XS-2` is `--cap 2`). The census after the last live leg is keyed `operator` and stands after the span.

**The remove-the-guard controls** are implement's one-shot `gate.py control` runs, never entries. Each fires on an entry filtered to its guard's own cases (ids within 16 characters, `inputs#I3` items 1–2). It reads «holds» only when its own case ran and FAILED with no TIMEOUT line. Each filter selects 0 tests on the tree before its case exists and at least one once it does. Revision 1 re-fires the three standing controls and adds `address-shape`:

| | `prefix-match` | `no-payload` | `unread-shape` | `address-shape` | |---|---|---|---|---| | **File** | `crates/viola-agent-claude/src/ledger.rs` | `src/cmd/hook.rs` | `crates/viola-agent-claude/src/ledger.rs` | `crates/viola-agent-claude/src/ledger.rs` | | **The edit removes** | the clause of `cross_session_reading` that reads `unprefixed` when `harness_prefix` is `None` | the payload guard inside `capture_names_only`: its `drop(bytes);` replaced by the `file_from(...)` filing (the case calls that function directly, testing.md 2026-09-25 ext. 2026-10-07; the stopped run's deviation 2) | the fall-through of `send_result_word` to `unread` (replaced by `refused`) | the byte-set refusal of `uds_address` (every byte accepted) | | **Case** | `cross_session_prefix_fails_when::case_2_no_prefix` | `names_only_capture_files_closed_words_and_no_payload` | `send_result_word_reads_only_the_boolean::case_5_success_a_string` | `uds_address_composes_the_cli_socket_name::case_4_a_space` | | **Fired on** | entry 16, `--timeout 300` | entry 17, `--timeout 600` | entry 18, `--timeout 300` | entry 19, `--timeout 300` |
